statements.notes: PRE-WORKOUT

FOR MAXIMUM BENEFIT, TAKE 1 SCOOP PER 100 LBS. OF BODY WEIGHT ONE HOUR PRIOR TO YOUR WORKOUT. ON NON-TRAINING DAYS, TAKE YOUR DAILY SERVING WITH YOUR LARGEST MEAL. IT IS NOT NECESSARY TO LOAD WHILE TAKING MET-Rx QUIK CREATINE HCL.
Creatine HCL 750 is a next generation formula featuring creatine hydrochloride. This concentrated formula supplies 750 milligrams of Creatine HCl per serving.
Our professional strength formula can be used by athletes, bodybuilders, and anyone training hard in the gym.

Directions: For adults take one (1) scoop (0.75 g) one hour prior to working out with 4-6 ounces of water. Quik-Creatine HCl can be taken with food, mixed with your favorite protein, or on an empty stomach. Creatine should be consumed within 10 minutes after mixing.

Training: 1 serving per 100 pounds of body weight.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: WARNING: Not intended for use by pregnant or nursing women. If you are taking any medications or have any medical condition, consult your doctor before use.
Avoid this product if you have kidney disease. Discontinue use and consult your doctor if any adverse reactions occur.
Not intended for use by persons under the age of 18.
